SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, PIN_YN AS pinYn FROM NOTICE WHERE 1=1
AND CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CREATED_AT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, PIN_YN AS pinYn FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, WRITER = #{writer}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
